name: Hone Blade
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 1, cleric 0, paladin 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (a small whetstone or lodestone chip)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target weapon touched (must be bladed)
Duration 1round/level or until first successful attack with enchanted weapon
Saving Throw Will negates (object, harmless); Spell Resistance yes (object, harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You magically sharpen the edge of any bladed weapon or object. The target weapon gets +1 to damage with its next successful hit during the spell duration. The spell also allows the weapon to overcome 1 point of DR for that one attack only.
